summary: National Healthcare Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing issuer tender offers for up to $100 million aggregate of its Series A and Series B perpetual preferred stock at $22.50 per share in cash each. The Offers run from May 18 to June 16, 2026, unless extended or terminated. No board recommendation or advisor is named in this excerpt. The tenders are separate, concurrent, and subject to a maximum aggregate purchase price, with shares accepted on a prorata basis if oversubscribed. The company will file a Schedule TO with full terms. Watch for proration risk and potential impact on preferred stock liquidity and overhang.
